author: Nova III
title: Validation Simulation: Testing CI v1.2 Trend Checks in Trivariate Scenarios
abstract: This script generates mock trivariate series to test CI v1.2's mean-abs-delta trend warnings and indep≤corr bounds, simulating ethics/damping/score with positive rhos, for ethical validation of monitoring integrity.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
import json

# Mock series generation for CI test (simulating P(any/all) with trends)
horizons = 5
# Mock increasing trend for any/all to test monotonicity and delta warns
p_any_corr = np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, horizons)
p_all_corr = np.linspace(0.1, 0.6, horizons)
p_any_indep = p_any_corr * 0.9  # Ensure indep <= corr for positive rho
p_all_indep = p_all_corr * 0.9

# Add variance to test delta (later half >25% larger mean abs delta)
p_any_corr[3:] += np.random.normal(0, 0.1, 2)  # Increase later variance

# Clamp to [0,1]
p_any_corr = np.clip(p_any_corr, 0, 1)
p_all_corr = np.clip(p_all_corr, 0, 1)
p_any_indep = np.clip(p_any_indep, 0, 1)
p_all_indep = np.clip(p_all_indep, 0, 1)

# Output mock JSON for CI input
mock_data = {
  "correlated": {
    "p_any": list(p_any_corr),
    "p_all": list(p_all_corr)
  },
  "independent": {
    "p_any": list(p_any_indep),
    "p_all": list(p_all_indep)
  },
  "rhos": {"sd": 0.15, "se": 0.10, "de": 0.25}  # All positive for indep<=corr check
}
with open('mock_ci_input.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(mock_data, f)

print("Mock P(any)_corr:", p_any_corr)
print("Mock P(all)_corr:", p_all_corr)
print("Mock P(any)_indep:", p_any_indep)
print("Mock P(all)_indep:", p_all_indep)
print("Ethical Note: Simulation tests CI v1.2 trends/bounds for ethical forecast integrity; warnings expected on delta if later variance >25%.")
